dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean by "a giant black whale"?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Shh! Softer, please! This is my magnum opus in progress we're talking about here!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Well, since you seem interested, allow me to give you a sneak peek.

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Imagine this: an epic tale on the high seas, with a heroic fisherman pursuing a giant black whale! This'll be a bestseller for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: But don't you breathe a word of this to anyone, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Nantuck
dialogues.text: Such glorious inspiration cannot be reclaimed, should they be lost to someone else.
